TEXT:
[FI] After practicing with Saori for a while, I brought 
her into my room.

[FI] It was about time for Kirino to come home, after 
all.

[FI] Plus, to some extent, our special training yielded 
results, so Saori's gotten used to at least holding 
hands with me while my eyes are open.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh yeah, we still haven't told them about us.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] You mean Kiririn-san and Kuroneko-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I wonder if it'll be alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] ...The reason most circles collapse... it's mostly caused 
by inter-club relationships...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You mean they object and quarrel about it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You sure worry about strange things.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Even if you say that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What's done is done, there's no use worrying about 
it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] We've already started dating, that can't be stopped 
now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Not only that, there's no way we can keep hiding 
this from them, right? Since they're our friends.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...Right.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] In that case, we should do what needs to be done. 
We can worry about what comes after seeing their 
reactions.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] ...I believe what you're thinking is right, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] ...Honestly, I am jealous... of the way you can be so 
insensitive, Kyosuke-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Umm, that wasn't a compliment just now, was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Oh my, aren't you truly amazing. You have 
understood me, yes?
[FI] Unlike Bajeena, Makishima-san uses sarcasm a lot.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, putting that problem aside.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Let's plan out the date for tomorrow.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] I don't know if it's you living in the moment, or if it's 
you looking forward... but I'm not being sarcastic 
when I say I want to learn from it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] We've solved some of your "shyness", so we can go 
out, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Indeed, probably.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is there somewhere you wanna go?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] ...Yes. Actually, there's a place I have been longing to 
visit for a while with you, Kyosuke-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, where, where?

[FI] Saori clapped her hands and spoke with a shining 
bright smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]The beach①[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't say such absurd things!
[FI] This girl says some crazy things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You said earlier it was impossible for you to hold 
hands, yet you're suddenly trying to jump an 
impossibly high hurdle!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Really, the beach! There are tons of people there, 
and since you have to wear a swimsuit, you'd die!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I-I will be fine! I will not slip up in that regard!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You can't come as Bajeena, alright?
[FI] Or else I'd be disappointed.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Yes, I understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You tried so hard, so I have no reason to object.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...But, I wonder if things will turn out okay?
